role: Independent saved-data assessment; no solver imported or state advanced

accuracy_units.pressure_cell_l1: Pa; volume-weighted primitive pressure error versus exact conservative cell projection
accuracy_units.pressure_cell_normalized_l1: Pressure cell-L1 divided by the model reference pressure scale; dimensionless
accuracy_units.h0_relative_linf_pct: Maximum absolute point total-enthalpy deviation as percent of analytical total enthalpy; deltas are percentage points

independence_limit: Residual decisions use saved reductions and BC/global data, not a new flux evaluation. Fresh-operator audit coverage is separately bound by digest; its complete flag refers to its own input snapshot.
interpretation: Local one-cell extrema, branch-envelope errors, point-reference accuracy and iteration counts are separate. No elapsed-time speedup or universal no-overshoot theorem is inferred.
